title: The Damascus Document, Cairo Genizah copies
description: Fifteen places where our transcription of the two Genizah copies of the Damascus Document (CD-A, T-S 10K6; CD-B, T-S 16.311) differs from Qimron's 2020 edition or where the 2000-pixel image leaves a letter open. Each item shows the disputed region enlarged, both readings, and one question.
